about.zh: 你递给 AI 一张黑白线稿，AMB 把线条交给线稿控制网，AI 在提示词里写颜色和画风，按线稿画出彩色的图。SDXL/NoobAI/Illustrious 用 Union 控制网的线稿模式。
about.en: From a black-on-white line drawing you hand the AI, its lines steer a lineart ControlNet while the prompt says the colours and style. SDXL, NoobAI and Illustrious use the union ControlNet's lineart mode.

source.zh: Union 控制网的线稿模式（参考工作流作者的控制网组用的就是 Union）
source.en: The union ControlNet's lineart mode (the reference workflow's ControlNet group uses a union model)

after: Set the picture's size to the drawing's shape (get_image_info on it; the empty latent's width and height), write the colours and style in the prompt (what is drawn, hair, clothes, background), then run_workflow. Its lines (white on black) are among the run's previews: if they are black on white, the drawing was light lines on dark: remove_nodes the ImageInvert and wire the picture straight in.
notes: A drawing is black lines on white; a lineart ControlNet reads white lines on black, hence ImageInvert.
